lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in multiple longitudinal rows and vertical columns posterior to the gill slits along the dorsal-lateral surface.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are aligned with the centroids of the circular blobs, creating a repeating rectilinear pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of low-contrast, high-luminance blobs visible on the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated toward the anterior base.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple dark, elongated pixel clusters adjacent to the ventral surface and pectoral fin, consistent with commensal organisms.
